title: Odyssey Summit

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the Fly Racing Odyssey Summit is purpose-built for adventure riders tackling varied weather and challenging backcountry trails across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1343g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~90 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Budget dual-sport with electric shield option and peak visor.

variants.title: Fly Racing Odyssey Summit Gloss Black
variants.description: The Fly Racing Odyssey Summit is a benchmark Adventure / Dual Sport helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Budget dual-sport with electric shield option and peak visor.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Fly Racing's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Odyssey Summit brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
variants.story:
The Fly Racing Odyssey Summit represents Fly Racing's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Fly Racing Odyssey Summit delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Fly Racing Odyssey Summit Gloss Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Fly Racing Odyssey Summit in Fly Racing Odyssey Summit Gloss Black. A dependable multi-surface helmet offering goggle versatility and certified impact protection for weekend trail blazers.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure and dual-sport riding; features a high-profile shell to accommodate goggles and ventilation systems typical of off-road use.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Fly Racing Odyssey Summit: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Fly Racing Odyssey Summit: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Fly Racing Odyssey Summit. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Global Fly Racing Odyssey Summit is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
